reviews.evidence: Added the missing integral definition with all four standard axioms in the opening: naturality, Whitney sum, c0=1 and vanishing above rank, and tautological-line normalization c1(O(-1))=-u on CP1. The core explains universal classes on BU(n), classifying-map uniqueness, and the flag-bundle splitting argument; its Chern–Weil paragraph distinguishes the real image from torsion. The tautological-line sign matches Hatcher, Vector Bundles and K-Theory, Chapter 3, §3.1, pp. 77–84, and the stated det(I+iF/(2pi)) convention. Root independently checked all axioms against Hatcher Theorem3.2 and added explicit isomorphism invariance/family quantification; CP1 normalization fixes CPinfinity generator via inclusion. Full topological bundle local triviality, pullback, Whitney and compatible smooth comparison read.

Added a complete topological definition: arbitrary-base topology, continuous surjection, constant complex-vector-space fibers, and local homeomorphisms to U times C^r that restrict fiberwise complex-linearly. The entry also defines continuous pullback and fiberwise direct sums, while recording the smooth direct-sum comparison only as an example.
